<?xml version="1.0"?>
<rdf:RDF xml:base="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#"

  <owl:Ontology rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#"/>

  <!-- owl:Class declarations -->

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#Permission">

    (competency_question) CQ08, CQ13, CQ14, CQ21, CQ26, New CQ6</dc:source>

    (competency_question) CQ31, CQ33, New CQ4</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#Action">

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#Asset">
